local_api_writable: only with a local API key

notes.switched_off: 403 text/plain 'Local API is not enabled' on every /api/ request, including writes and /api/ itself (observed live, captures in local/off/); /connector/ping stays up
notes.writes: refused with 428 'Zotero-Server-ID not provided' without that header, 401 without a local API key, 412 if the server id is wrong; a key comes from POST /api/local/authorize, which asks the person in the app (Allow / Always Allow / Deny). The Web API key is not accepted. Once authorised (the person chose Always Allow) writes work: create/update/delete with the same envelope as the Web API, but a stale version fails with a key and the text 'item version mismatch: expected N, found M', and extra 'PMID: n' is migrated into the native PMID field. Captures in local/write/granted-*.
notes.csljson: a JSON-encoded STRING holding a one-element array, not an object
